attributes.title: 2027 ANA-Vermont Annual Conference and Advocacy Day
attributes.series: ANA-Vermont Annual Conference and Advocacy Day
attributes.venue: Capitol Plaza Hotel Montpelier, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
attributes.summary:
ANA-Vermont's 2027 Annual Conference and Advocacy Day takes place February 1 and 2, 2027, at the Capitol Plaza Hotel in Montpelier, across the street from the State House. The focus is advocacy, health policy and legislation affecting Vermont nurses.

The save-the-date lists 3.0 CE credits with approval pending. The agenda, speakers and registration fees are not published yet.
